setup.title: First-time setup
setup.subtitle: 3 steps, a few minutes. Everything is stored on this machine.

license.title: Get started
license.desc: Free 5-hour trial, no card needed. The clock starts at your first question, not during setup.
license.email_hint: Used to remind you before the trial ends. One trial per machine.
license.key_hint: You get it after subscribing. Move between machines with the same key.

ai.title: Connect AI
ai.desc: Bring your own key and pay the provider directly. We add no markup.
ai.mode_gemini_desc: Simplest. One key for answering and document search.
ai.mode_both_desc: The combination we have tested most for accuracy. Needs 2 keys.
ai.gemini_help: Create one free in Google AI Studio
ai.privacy_note: Note: on Gemini's free tier Google may use your data to improve its services. Use a paid key for sensitive data.

password.title: Admin password
password.desc: Stops others on your network from changing settings. Recommended if other machines can open this page.
password.from_env: The password is already set in this machine's config file.
password.login_note: After this, your browser will ask for the username and password.

finish.title: You're ready
finish.desc: Next: create a knowledge base and upload your documents, then create a bot and start asking.

errors.demo_used: This machine or email has already used the trial. Subscribe to continue with the same key.
errors.credential_invalid: The API key is invalid or lacks permission. Check that you copied all of it.
errors.provider_quota_exhausted: The API key is out of quota or credit.
errors.central_unreachable: Can't reach central. Check your internet connection.
errors.tunnel_offline: The local database isn't connected to central yet. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
